title: Invoice charger retrying a payment gateway
name: Invoice charge retrier

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code retries charge attempts against the gateway? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
With DEFAULT_BACKOFF, the gateway keeps returning 503. How many POSTs are made before charge() returns?
What range can the sleep after the first failed attempt fall in?
How does the charger treat a 429 response compared with a 400?
choices: 429 is retried with backoff; 400 throws without retrying
